results.title: 219 Sewerage Projects Under Namami Gange; 146 Completed, Says MoS Raj Bhushan Chaudhary in Lok Sabha
results.description: MoS Jal Shakti Raj Bhushan Chaudhary tells LS that 219 sewerage projects under Namami Gange Mission-II; 146 completed with 4,263 MLD capacity, boosting Ganga water quality.

results.title: MP: Artists from 6 BRICS nations showcase culture in Bhopal
results.description: Artists from Belarus, Brazil, Indonesia, Russia, UAE, and India showcase music, dance, and folk art at the BRICS Cultural Festival in Bhopal, promoting cultural harmony.

results.title: Union Minister Sonowal pitches technology-led maritime security framework as India's Port network expands
results.description: Union Minister Sarbananda Sonowal urges technology-led maritime security, citing cyber threats and port expansion, at the 2nd National Port Security Conference 2026.

results.title: Centre releases Rs 6 crore to states under Jal Jeevan Mission 2.0; CR Patil reviews state-wise progress
results.description: Centre releases Rs 6,150 crore under Jal Jeevan Mission 2.0; UP gets highest share, Assam tops SNA SPARSH platform. CR Patil reviews progress.

results.title: Netanyahu dials PM Modi, India, Israel reaffirm special strategic ties
results.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi received a phone call from Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Thursday evening. The two leaders reviewed progress in the India-Israel Special Strategic Partnership and exchanged views on the situation in West Asia. They reaffirmed their commitment to strengthening bilateral cooperation across sectors and agreed to remain in touch.
